# Test fixtures

All files are synthetic and generated by `make_fixtures.py` (`make fixtures`);
nothing here is recorded speech or copyrighted material.

| File | Content | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `silence_5s.wav` | 5 s digital silence, 16 kHz mono PCM | decode tests, integration "silence -> empty text" |
| `tone_10s.wav` | 10 s 220 Hz tone with slow envelope + light noise | decode/duration tests, integration schema test |
| `tone_10s.webm` | the same, WebM/Opus 24 kbit/s | container sniffing (Chrome `MediaRecorder` output) |
| `tone_10s.m4a` | the same, MP4/AAC 32 kbit/s | container sniffing (iOS / expo-audio output) |
| `tone_10s.ogg` | the same, Ogg/Opus | container sniffing |
| `tone_10s.mp3` | the same, MP3 32 kbit/s | container sniffing |

Real speech for the `-m model` integration tests is **not** committed. The
test tries to fetch one public-domain FLEURS `hr_hr` utterance through the
Hugging Face datasets-server API into `engine/models/fixtures/` (git-ignored)
and skips with a reason when that is not reachable.
